hints.title: Prefix Sum Difference Counting
hints.text: Compute prefix sums and count pairs whose difference falls between lower and upper bounds using divide and conquer.

hints.title: Merge Sort Interval Two Pointers
hints.text: While merge-sorting the prefix sum array, for each index in the left half, find the range of valid matching indices in the right half.

hints.title: Divide and Conquer Range Counting
hints.text: Construct prefix sums array. Recursively count in left and right halves. In the merge step: for each i in left half, advance pointer j to find first prefix[j] - prefix[i] >= lower, and pointer k for first prefix[k] - prefix[i] > upper. Add k - j to count. Merge sorted subarrays.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal divide-and-conquer merge sort range counting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all O(N^2) subarray sums directly causes time limit exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Merge sorting prefix sums allows two pointers to sweep matching range bounds in O(N log N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use 64-bit integer prefix sums to prevent overflow and count ranges in-line during merge.
